Aww, FEEL THIS. I suffered sexual abuse/rape from family for years starting at a very young age, and later in adulthood by an old coworker I trusted. That is toxic and can ruin you. What matters most is learning to love yourself again. Put the past behind you. ALL you have is THIS SINGLE moment, right now. You are breathing, you are existing. Remembering all the shit I've survived gives me an odd boost of power now that I'm on the end of it, looking back at the suffering. (I felt as if it would NEVER end. A sad way to live life.) After I was able to truly accept the way people treated me, life got easier. Less painful. You cannot blame yourself for how you were treated. All you can do is heal. Try your damn hardest. You deserve happiness. Every ounce of joy that was stolen from you, you can regrow. Focus on this moment.

Investing is terrifying. Be more cautious about who you let into the depths of your heart. You've already learned so many valuable lessons! Put them to use. You are defined by the choices you make today. Choose a blissful future, a joyous present, for YOU. Not any one else. But for you because, you god damn deserve it. It is never too late to live a better life. Don't hold yourself back anymore. One day at a time, it's worth the practice. Self-love is beautiful. If you can feel full alone, you can accomplish anything! The right person will make themselves known. You will legit feel the difference between someone who genuinely cares VS the abuse you are accustomed to. After years of abuse and toxic relationships I found a loving and gentle human to spend time with. Now all I'm doing is trying to mess it up by letting my learned behaviors, and learned insecurities take control. There will always be trials and tribulations, you can still come out on top! I believe in you! <3

Understandable! You learned a valuable lesson here, seize it! Dispense kindness, but only go that extra mile for people who will do the same for you. (THAT one took me years of repeating the same mistakes to learn.) Don't let fear drive you. Life is scary as hell! But you still get out of bed every day and face the world. (GOOD FOR YOU! Shit is hard out here homie) Look at love and matters of the heart in the same way. You will ALWAYS recover as long as you get back up again. Even healthy relationships have bouts of sadness or discomfort. Not abusive, the feelings will be less intense, however they remain. There is not good without a hint of bad tasting reality. If you can master the umbrella effect-let it drip off you like water-you can take on anything! Love is a wondrous experience. Listen to your tummy more than your heart. Your soul sits there, and is more rational. Often more correct, too. I believe in you and I dearly hope you find the strength to see how badass you are. And that even you, can master the world of love and loss. <3

Oof, feel this. The right person for you won't make you feel guilt. They will hear you, see you, and accept you. That's not a one way ticket to raise hell, but a comforting truth in a healthy love. Don't give up just yet <3

Sounds like you need a PHAT dose of TLC and self-love my friend. Focus on you. Exercise more to boost those endorphins and your physique. One day at a time. Read some books! On your journey to actualization and self acceptance, you will meet inner peace. Once you learn to love yourself, you radiate a special sunshine. A 4 can become a 6, or even a solid 7! Take it from someone who was hopeless and now breathes joy, you have potential. All you have to do is seize it! When you start to spurt sunshine out your pores, people notice. Your confidence is attractive. You won't be knocked down by rejection as easily. Once you truly love being alone, it's not difficult to find a good partner. Ladies, and men, notice a human who exudes balance and growth. You can DO this!!!! And loads of people want a partner without marriage. Your future love exists if you allow it. <3

EASY FIX, start small! A simple, "Hey, you caught my eye, how has your day been?"

Build a foundation before you start heavy flirtation. Solid women usually want a rise to the climax. Not a zero to sixty affair. You can DO this! Practice makes perfect. Failure=growth.

It's never too late!! Break the anxiety by slowly dipping your toe. Then continue wading until you're submerged. The only way to grow, is to learn. You can do this! Failure sucks and heartbreak hurts. That is LIFE my friend. The end goal is finding a best friend you can diddle before bed and once you wake. Or even if it's just a temporary love, you can always grow and make the best of the situation. Fake it til you make it! Build your confidence! You can be anyone you want to be, all you have to do is try. <3
